anonymousText: The school does not see who gave which answer. It only sees results after the survey has ended and once there are {min} answers.
anonymousTextHint: Please do not write any names if you want to stay anonymous.
notAnonymousText: The school sees your name next to your answers.
parentOneAnswer: You answer once for your parent account, not for each child.
finalHint: Once you send your answer, you cannot change it.
multipleHint: You can choose more than one answer
scaleLegend: 1 = does not apply at all, 5 = fully applies
missingRequired: Please answer all required questions first.
thanksTitle: Thank you, your answer has been saved.
thanksText: Your answer can no longer be changed.
